h: The Overlook Cliffs: kill these as you meet them

l.x: Les grosses tortues rampent sur les plages au nord du village. Les bouteilles de Porto Pupellyverbos de Whiskey Slim se trouvent aussi sur ces plages, mais sa quête ne fait pas partie de cet itinéraire. Une Gueule d'acier des mers peut laisser tomber la Balise de détresse OOX-09/HL, rarement : gardez-la.
Tuez Saltwater Snapjaw ×15

h: The Overlook Cliffs: kill these as you meet them

l.x: These are elite mobs: grouping up is encouraged, look for people to do it with. Gammerita is a level 48 elite: most classes solo it at level 50, but you may need help. Skip it if you are alone: the route has you grind the XP back.
Récupérez 1 × Le meilleur appât de Katoom sur Gammerita
Le Secret de Rin'ji se trouve sur The Overlook Cliffs, au-dessus de la plage.

Au nord le long de la côte, le panier de pique-nique de Lard est sur la petite île ; un Kidnapper Vilebranch le garde.
Récupérez 1 × Repas de Lard sur Kidnapper Vilebranch
Rendez « Devinette de Cortello » (Trésor de Cortello) — Underwater

h: Shaol'watha: kill these as you meet them

l.x: West of the island, the Vilebranch scalpers hold the temples of Agol'watha and Shaol'watha. Slagtree's tools lie at one of the temples. The Silvermane Stalkers, Savage Owlbeasts and Razorbeak Skylords share the hills between the temples and Skulk Rock. Use the Récipient d'Indomptable miniaturisé on the owlbeasts you kill. The Skylords also drop Long Elegant Feathers: keep ten for Otho Moji'ko's second message. Careful: Silvermane Stalkers are level 47-48 and stay stealthed while out of combat. Up close they use Infected Bite. When a Hurleur Crins-d'argent falls to 50% health or lower, it calls for help from anything within 25 yd.
Tuez Silvermane Stalker ×10

h: The Altar of Zul: kill these as you meet them

l.x: On the way back east, the Vilebranch soothsayers hold the The Altar of Zul, the troll temple south of the central hills. Qiaga and Morta'gya la Gardienne (elite, 50) stand at its top: take the soothsayers on the lower steps. South-west, the Silvermane Howlers roam the hills east of the Witherbark villages.
Tuez Vilebranch Scalper ×30
Tuez Vilebranch Soothsayer ×15
Tuez Silvermane Howler ×10

Only with the distress beacon: the robot sits at the head of the river west of Skulk Rock. Escort it east to the shore beyond the The Overlook Cliffs; its reward waits with Oglethorpe in Booty Bay. Careful: Two ambushes spawn during the escort: first three wildkin owlbeasts, then three trolls. Before each, the robot halts and announces it senses danger. Oozes, stealthed wolves and a large turtle along the path can join fights, and they respawn even if cleared beforehand.

h: Serpent's Coil: kill these as you meet them

l.x: The five quests share the same parts: gather them all in one sweep. West of the road the Pourfendeur noir vultures, Starving Snickerfangs, Scorpok Stingers and Deatheye basilisks share the hills. East of the road the Ashmane boars and Grunters root on the slopes beside the Redstone basilisks. Stay away from the level 52 Helboars further south. Careful: Scorpok Stingers use Venom Sting; Clack le Ravageur adds Knockdown.
